beta1_finding.summary: An artifact URL supplied by package-index JSON was opened without independent origin, redirect, or response-size enforcement.

controls: HTTPS-only validation before every package-index metadata and artifact request
independent exact host allowlists for PyPI, TestPyPI, and their artifact hosts
default HTTPS port only; username and password URL components rejected
expected path prefixes; query strings and fragments rejected
all redirects rejected and the effective response URL revalidated
package-index size metadata must exactly match the reviewed local file
Content-Length must be numeric, bounded, and equal to reviewed size when present
streamed byte count is enforced when Content-Length is absent or untrusted
downloaded bytes retain the existing exact SHA-256 comparison
errors omit remote URLs and do not contain credentials
non-HTTPS and local-file schemes fail closed
limitations: urllib exposes one request timeout value rather than separately configurable connect and read timeouts.
The verifier is intentionally coupled to the existing arx-prescanner project and the documented PyPI infrastructure origins.
